$comment: Item 7 Phase C ratchet. The number of raw, STATIC oklch() literals still
left in src/app/admin/** and src/components/ui/**. It may only ever go
DOWN. Lower it when you remove literals; never raise it.
This started at 717. The Phase B sweep took it to 154 by substituting
every literal whose colour was numerically identical to an existing
token's light value. Item 7's tail took it to 1 by minting a token pair
for each of the 58 remaining distinct colours.
It cannot reach 0 — see dynamicAllowance below, and staticRemainder.
⛔ WHAT THIS GUARD CANNOT SEE, measured rather than merely disclosed:
it matches the source text `oklch(`, so the same problem in another
colour syntax is invisible to it. As of this writing that is 6 rgba()
occurrences (inset highlights and shadow ink in dashboard-filters-client,
attention-group-client and notification-bell) and 10 hex literals in two
files that emit standalone email-preview HTML — email-templates/preview/
[id]/route.ts and emails/templates/components/LivePreview.tsx. Those are
email paper and theme-neutral shadow, i.e. things that SHOULD NOT invert,
which is why they are out of scope rather than merely unswept. hsl(),
lab(), lch() and color() do not occur at all. Re-measure before assuming
these numbers still hold.
SCAN_DIRS covers src/app/admin and src/components/ui. One shared
component rendered inside /admin lives outside both —
src/components/address/AddressAutocompleteField.tsx, imported by
admin/bookings/new/ManualBookingForm.tsx and by the public booking flow.
It carries zero colour literals today, so the gap is currently theoretical;
a colour added there would be invisible to this ratchet AND would ship to
the public site.
The one static literal left, and why it is not substituted.
src/app/admin/clients/page.tsx:1121 spells its arbitrary value with RAW
SPACES — `hover:border-b-[oklch(60% 0.08 247)]`. Tailwind cannot compile
an arbitrary value containing spaces, so the class never generated and
that hover border has never rendered. Pointing it at a token would make
the class valid and switch on a visual effect for the first time, which
is not a substitution; deleting it would discard evident design intent.
Both are Owner calls, so it stays counted rather than quietly resolved.
Computed-hue literals like `oklch(88% 0.025 ${hue})`, where the hue is
derived per identity (hueFromId(staff.id)) so each person gets their own
avatar/chip colour. They live in inline style={{}} objects, not Tailwind
classes, and have NO static token equivalent — a token is one fixed
value, and the entire point of these is that the value varies per row.
Plan section 7.8 specifies flipping this guard to zero-tolerance 'on
completion'. That is unreachable while these exist, and section 7 never
mentions them. They are allowed by count and by file here instead, so a
NEW dynamic literal in a NEW file still fails the guard.
